segments.ja198:1.3: Kaccinnu tāta te mātā, na aññamupasevati.
segments.ja198:2.1: Na kho panetaṃ subhaṇaṃ, giraṃ saccupasaṃhitaṃ;
segments.ja198:2.3: Sayetha poṭṭhapādova, mummure [mummure (syā.), maṃ pure (ka.) mummurasaddo thusaggimhi kukkuḷe ca vattatīti sakkatābhidhānesu] upakūthitoti [upakūsitoti (sī. syā. pī.), upakūlito (ka.)].

lines: Tañhi yathā idāni girā, evaṃ tadā “giran”ti vuccati, so suvapotako liṅgaṃ anādiyitvā evamāha.
Ayaṃ panettha attho – tāta, paṇḍitena nāma saccupasaṃhitaṃ yathābhūtaṃ atthayuttaṃ sabhāvavacanampi aniyyānikaṃ na subhaṇaṃ.
Aniyyānikañca saccaṃ bhaṇanto sayetha poṭṭhapādova, mummure upakūthito, yathā poṭṭhapādo kukkuḷe jhāmo sayati, evaṃ sayeyyāti.
